verdict.rationale: DeepInfra states a default zero retention policy covering inputs, outputs, and user data, backed by SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification. It also offers dedicated instances with data isolation and a private endpoint. That addresses data-retention privacy, but nothing in the evidence describes a user-controlled opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out control, documentation of what usage metadata is collected, and independent or hands-on verification of the zero-retention claim.
